Multiplying the matrices using the usual method, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}AB & =[\begin{aligned}2+3\text{i} & 1+2\text{i} \\ 2+\text{i} & 4+4\text{i}\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}3+2\text{i} & 2+\text{i} \\ 1+2\text{i} & 2+2\text{i}\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}(2+3\text{i})(3+2\text{i})+(1+2\text{i})(1+2\text{i}) & (2+3\text{i})(2+\text{i})+(1+2\text{i})(2+2\text{i}) \\ (2+\text{i})(3+2\text{i})+(4+4\text{i})(1+2\text{i}) & (2+\text{i})(2+\text{i})+(4+4\text{i})(2+2\text{i})\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}13\text{i}+(-3+4\text{i}) & (1+8\text{i})+(-2+6\text{i}) \\ (4+7\text{i})+(-4+12\text{i}) & (3+4\text{i})+16\text{i}\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-3+17\text{i} & -1+14\text{i} \\ 19\text{i} & 3+20\text{i}\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
